visual.general_description: Single grayscale axial abdominal CT image with contrast, showing both kidneys with bright central regions and a darker peripheral band.
visual.detailed_description: One grayscale axial cross-section of the abdomen on a black background, with no printed text, arrows, scale or labels. The spine is a bright white round vertebral body at the lower center, with a small dark spinal canal behind it. A bright round vessel lies directly in front of the vertebral body at the center. On each side of the spine, in the posterior abdomen, is a kidney. In both kidneys the bright contrast-filled parts are in the central and inner regions, and a darker gray band lies around the outside of these bright regions; the bright region of the kidney on the image right is larger and more continuous than that on the image left. A large gas-filled bowel loop is black at the top center of the image, and smaller dark gas pockets lie along the right edge. A large homogeneous mid-gray region occupies the left edge of the image. A rounded heterogeneous region of mixed gray density with a small very bright round spot beside it lies in the upper left of the center. Wide areas of uniform dark-gray low density fill much of the abdomen between these structures and the abdominal wall. Ribs appear as bright white ovals along the lower sides.

visual.general_description: Four-part histology figure: a low-power strip of three tissue segments labelled M, D and O above three higher-power fields labelled B, C and D.
visual.detailed_description: A top row labelled A holds one wide strip made of three adjoining tissue pieces, labelled M, D and O from left to right in the lower left corner of each piece, stained blue and pink-red. The O piece on the right contains several round dark magenta-red structures scattered across it, the D piece in the middle has a few round pale structures with open centers and a small cluster of magenta structures at its upper right, and the M piece on the left is mostly pale pink with blue fibrous areas. Below are three square fields labelled B, C and D from left to right. Panel B shows one large round structure filled with densely packed magenta-red rounded cells, surrounded by a thin blue outline and blue fibrous tissue with pale pink tubule profiles at the corners. Panel C shows blue-gray tubular profiles with pale pink edges and faint outlines, with a cluster of magenta-red cells at the lower left. Panel D shows one round structure with an open network of thin blue lines inside and few red cells, surrounded by a thin blue outline and by tubules with pale pink cell borders. No scale bars or other printed text appear besides the letters A to D and M, D and O.
